More customized models are blocked by data limitations. During this cycle, we obtained more than 20 million data samples, setting up a new standard for datasets which provide enough scale but also have fresh data that is lacking in existing datasets.

The two key components—data freshness and scale—enable us to enhance Xeno agents and models with real-world knowledge, characteristics, personas, and even traits like humor or sarcasm. Creating countless datasets that are highly focused on one key feature.
